source_clauses.verbatim: I want a wall-mounted dispenser for small items.
It should hold about twenty of them
and release exactly one each time I press a lever, so I never get two at once.
I refill it from the top without taking it off the wall.
It must not jam when it is nearly empty.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I want a wall-mounted dispenser for small items.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The product is attached to a wall and dispenses small items.

requirements.statement_verbatim: It should hold about twenty of them
requirements.observable_verbatim: The product holds approximately twenty items.

requirements.statement_verbatim: and release exactly one each time I press a lever, so I never get two at once.
requirements.observable_verbatim: Pressing the lever dispenses exactly one item; never two items from a single press.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I refill it from the top without taking it off the wall.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The user can refill the product through a top opening while the product remains attached to the wall.

requirements.statement_verbatim: It must not jam when it is nearly empty.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The product dispenses correctly when its contents are nearly empty.

scenarios.name: Dispensing operation
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the dispenser mechanism including the lever and the storage volume. Outside: the wall surface it is mounted on, the user pressing the lever, and the items to be dispensed.

scenarios.name: Refilling process
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the dispenser including its storage volume and its mounting interface. Outside: the wall surface it is attached to, the user performing the refill, and the items being added.
scenarios.environment: Dispenser remains attached to the wall during refill.

freedoms.decision: The text does not specify the type of small items, the dispenser dimensions, materials, or the mechanism by which the lever releases an item.
freedoms.why_free: The request only states the desired functionality and constraints; the implementation details are left open for the designer.

ambiguities.statement: The lever is mentioned as the control for dispensing, but its placement, shape, and method of operation are not specified.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: When user preferences or ergonomic requirements are defined.

ambiguities.statement: The phrase 'about twenty' is approximate; the exact intended capacity is not defined.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: When the user or stakeholder provides a specific capacity or tolerance.

assumptions.statement: The dispenser is intended for indoor use on a wall.
assumptions.why: A wall-mounted dispenser is typically used indoors, though the request does not specify the environment.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the request specifies an outdoor or mobile application.

assumptions.statement: The items are uniform and can be dispensed one at a time by a simple mechanism.
assumptions.why: The request implies that a single lever press releases one item, which requires some control over item dispensing.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the items are irregularly shaped or difficult to separate mechanically.
